The '''Museum of Spintir''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Reles]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]].

==History==
[[File:Museum_of_Spintir_layout.png|thumb|left|The museum layout]]
The museum was located on the outskirts of the [[University of Reles]]'s campus, and near the walled estate of Spintir's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Caria Haal]]. She arranged for Imperial grants to the university, most of which went towards security. The museum housed a portion of the governor's private collection there, including a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], alongside other relics. A skywalk went from the museum and over the walls of the governor's estate, where a secure wing housed the governor's collection.<ref name="LotL" />

Not open to the general public, the museum was toured by the more wealthy citizens of Reles and visiting dignitaries.<ref name="LotL" />
